local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local ServiceFramework = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("ServiceFramework"))

-- Core Services
local DataService = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("DataService"))

local PetService = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("PetService"))
local ZoneService = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("ZoneService"))

local MonetizationService = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("MonetizationService"))
local RewardService = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("RewardService"))

local GameplayService = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("GameplayService"))

ServiceFramework:RegisterService("DataService", DataService)
ServiceFramework:RegisterService("PetService", PetService)
ServiceFramework:RegisterService("ZoneService", ZoneService)
ServiceFramework:RegisterService("MonetizationService", MonetizationService)
ServiceFramework:RegisterService("RewardService", RewardService)
ServiceFramework:RegisterService("GameplayService", GameplayService)

ServiceFramework:Init()

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local GameDataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("GameData_v1")

local function setupPlayerData(player)
	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local candy = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	candy.Name = "Candy"
	candy.Value = 0
	candy.Parent = leaderstats

	local coins = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	coins.Name = "Coins"
	coins.Value = 0
	coins.Parent = leaderstats

	local rebirths = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	rebirths.Name = "Rebirths"
	rebirths.Value = 0
	rebirths.Parent = leaderstats

	local data = nil
	local success, err = pcall(function()
		data = GameDataStore:GetAsync(tostring(player.UserId))
	end)

	if success and data then
		candy.Value = data.Candy or 0
		coins.Value = data.Coins or 0
		rebirths.Value = data.Rebirths or 0
	end
end

local function savePlayerData(player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if leaderstats then
		local data = {
			Candy = leaderstats.Candy.Value,
			Coins = leaderstats.Coins.Value,
			Rebirths = leaderstats.Rebirths.Value
		}
		pcall(function()
			GameDataStore:SetAsync(tostring(player.UserId), data)
		end)
	end
end

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.spawn(setupPlayerData, player)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayerData)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(savePlayerData)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		savePlayerData(player)
	end
end)
